claims.text: Wait for the genesis block to load rather than handling a null tip in checkBlock with mostly dead code
claims.quote: I think it would be better to not have to think about the tip being nullptr. This just adds mostly dead code that is practically only reachable in rare races or test envs. Just waiting a millisecond more to load the genesis block seems conceptually easier?
claims.status_note: author agreed and implemented this approach in commit 8cba4ba

support.reason: makeMining() now waits for a tip the same way createNewBlock() and waitTipChanged() already do.
